messages:
elaine: quick heads-up 1 BetaBank wants a clear migration path from the old prompt param to a messages-first API. must-haves: pinned system persona and deterministic JSON outputs for payments routing. can we target Q2?

rafa: short take yes to messages alias. pinned persona requires tenant-level enforcement + RBAC. infra work needed to attach tenant flags early.

kevin (eng): implementation sketch: accept top-level prompt -> map to messages: [{role:"user",content:prompt}]. support tenant.pinned_system that, when enforced, prepends/overrides any client-supplied system message. reject on conflict when enforced=true.

nina (solutions): customer asks: function_call + JSON Schema enforcement. they want invalid outputs blocked and surfaced as structured errors to their app.

tom (sdk): SDK changes: helpers to convert prompt->messages, warn on system conflicts, helpers to parse function_call response and validate against JSON Schema. estimate ~10 dev days across py/js.

kevin (eng): schema modes proposal:
- strict: validate and return 422 + {code,message,validation_errors} on mismatch
- soft-log: return assistant text + warning header and telemetry
- fixup: attempt to coerce then return repaired payload + metadata
Hosted default = soft-log. Dedicated/private can opt into strict.

elaine: launch gates (draft): messages+prompt alias, pinned_system enforcement, function calling + schema modes, SDK helpers, migration guide, evals show no material regressions, docs + rollback plan.

rafa: timeline rough: runtime 3w, SDKs 2w parallel, docs 1w, canary ops 1w. resources: 2 backend, 1 infra, 1 SDK, 0.5 QA.

kevin (eng): QA needs a harness for schema violations (truncated tokens, partial JSON, type mismatches). add to CI matrix including quantized model variants.

nina (solutions): I'll draft customer migration checklist and example requests, include expected error shapes.

ops-bot: scheduled job created: schema-canary-healthcheck (interval=5m) pending start.

elaine: next actions: @kevin open runtime ticket with acceptance criteria + example error shapes, @tom open SDK ticket + estimate, @rafa schedule infra window for canary, @nina draft BetaBank migration proposal. tag me when tickets are up. thanks!
